name: A10-0300/2026 – Pierre Pimpie – § 29 – Am 8
title: REPORT on the implementation of the VAT reverse-charge mechanism
part_text: 29. Stresses that any extension or adjustment must not require businesses, regardless of their size, to submit an additional periodic return or to repeatedly provide information already held by the relevant tax authorities, and must take account of their compliance costs, including adaptation costs and costs resulting from transaction classification, reporting obligations and legal uncertainty; notes that access to disaggregated costs, distinguishing the burden borne by SMEs from that borne by large operators, would facilitate a proportionality assessment of the RCM;
